Close Strategy

This command will close an ATM Strategy and requires a strategy ID value. The strategy ID value must match a strategy ID given to a strategy in the PLACE command. This command will close the specified strategy.

Scoped to one ATM strategy id, so anything else on the instrument keeps running.

Example Payload​
key=your-secret-key;

command=closestrategy;

strategy_id=atm-strategy-id;

NOT AVAILABLE ON TRADOVATE

closestrategy closes a NinjaTrader ATM strategy, and Tradovate has no ATM strategy concept. With destination=tradovate; the alert is rejected with a clear error. To exit on Tradovate, use closeposition or flatten.
